title: BackendSetError exhaustive-match catch-all reports unactionable 'unhandled backend error variant'
description:
src/filenode.rs has 5 instances of the pattern:

  Err(_) => {
      not_created/not_updated/not_destroyed.insert(
          create_id,
          json!({ "type": "serverFail", "description": "unhandled backend error variant" }),
      );
  }

(lines 285-294, 465-473, 556-564, 650-660, 694-702). These catch-all arms exist because BackendSetError is #[non_exhaustive] (workspace AGENTS.md mandate). The forward-compat rationale is correct.

Problem: when the upstream BackendSetError gains a new variant, every consumer will silently start returning 'serverFail: unhandled backend error variant' for that variant. The error message gives:
- no variant name,
- no error context,
- no way for the client to distinguish this from a generic server fault.

For workspace internal debugging this is unactionable too — the only thing the user knows is 'something happened and the handler did not know about it'.

Required: at minimum, debug-format the error variant: 'description': format!("unhandled BackendSetError variant: {e:?}"). Better: file a workspace-level bead to add a catch-all method on BackendSetError that returns a stable string label, so the catch-all arm here can extract a discriminator without depending on Debug format stability.

Also: confirm the same pattern exists in canonical jmap-mail-server (since this crate must mirror); if so, the fix belongs in the canonical first and propagates via the workspace canonical-templates sweep.
notes:
DECISION Mark 2026-10-22: option (a) keep BackendSetError #[non_exhaustive] and the catch-all arms; make each of the 94 arms Debug-format the error into the serverFail description. Follow the workspace redaction rule: never put a backend error's secret-bearing content on the wire (check JmapBackend::Error Display/Debug redaction policy, JMAP-jfia.20); if Debug could leak storage detail, use the variant/type name only.
DECISION REFINED Mark 2026-10-22: keep #[non_exhaustive] and the 94 catch-all arms, but each arm's serverFail description names only the kind (e.g. 'unhandled BackendSetError variant'), never the error content: backend error text stays off the wire per the redaction rule (server_fail_from_backend + canary). Supersedes the earlier 'Debug-format' note.
NOTE Mark 2026-10-22: the 'keep the 94 catch-all arms' part is superseded by JMAP-510h.18 option (A); non_exhaustive and kind-only descriptions stay.
